name: Snorri
title: the Runescribe

cards.name: Rune Sigils
cards.text:
Target a unit adjacent to you; if a rune is active:
{rune_bird}: You may target a minion in range instead.
{rune_axe}: +3 {attack} Attack.
{rune_anvil}: If you target a hero, gain 3 coins.
{rune_horn}: Repeat once on a different hero in range.

cards.name: Inscribe the Runes
cards.text:
Give yourself 4 {rune_axe_marker}{rune_bird_marker}{rune_anvil_marker}{rune_horn_marker} Rune markers and place one below each of your turn slots.
A rune is active as long as it is below the turn slot matching the current turn.
Rune markers are not removed at the end of round, nor if you are defeated.

cards.name: Runic Dagger
cards.text:
Target a unit adjacent to you.
After the attack: If the {rune_anvil} rune is active, you may retrieve a discarded card.

cards.name: Oath of Endurance
cards.text:
If a rune is active:
• {rune_horn}: Block a basic attack.
• {rune_axe}: Block a non-ranged attack.
This Turn: You are immune to enemy actions.

cards.name: Safe Passage
cards.text:
If the {rune_bird} rune is active,
This turn: You may ignore obstacles.

cards.name: Runic Hammer
cards.text:
Before the attack: If the {rune_horn} rune is active, you may move 1 space.
Target a unit adjacent to you.
After the attack: If the {rune_anvil} rune is active, you may retrieve a discarded card.

cards.name: Runecaster
cards.text:
Target a unit at maximum range.
After the attack: If a rune is active:
• {rune_horn}: Move up to 2 spaces.
• {rune_axe}: An enemy hero who was adjacent to the target discards a card, or is defeated.

cards.name: Oath of Fortitude
Runetrap
cards.text:
If a rune is active, an enemy hero in radius:
• {rune_horn}: Discards a green card, if able.
• {rune_axe}: Discards a silver card, if able.
• {rune_anvil}: Discards a blue card, if able.

cards.name: Hidden Passage
cards.text:
If a rune is active:
• {rune_bird}: This turn: You may ignore obstacles.
• {rune_anvil}: This turn: You are immune to enemy actions.

cards.name: Ancestral Boon
cards.text:
If a rune is active, a friendly hero in radius may:
• {rune_axe}: Swap a resolved card with a card in hand.
• {rune_anvil}: Retrieve all their discarded cards.

cards.name: Runic Battleaxe
cards.text:
Before the attack: If the {rune_horn} rune is active, you may move 1 space.
Target a unit adjacent to you.
After the attack: If a rune is active:
{rune_axe}: May repeat once on an enemy minion.
{rune_anvil}: You may retrieve a discarded card.

cards.name: Runeblaster
cards.text:
If the {rune_bird} rune is active, target a unit in range, otherwise target a unit at maximum range.
After the attack: If a rune is active:
• {rune_horn}: Move up to 2 spaces.
• {rune_axe}: An enemy hero who was adjacent to the target discards a card, or is defeated.

cards.name: Oath of Perseverance
Runebomb
cards.text:
Choose one active rune; depending on that rune, an enemy hero in radius:
• {rune_horn}: Discards a green card, if able.
• {rune_axe}: Discards a silver card, if able.
• {rune_anvil}: Discards a blue card, if able.
• {rune_bird}: Discards a gold card, if able.

cards.name: Deep Passage
cards.text:
If a rune is active:
• {rune_bird}: This turn: You may ignore obstacles.
• {rune_anvil}: This turn: You are immune to enemy actions.
• {rune_horn}: Gain +2 {movement} Movement.

cards.name: Ancestral Grace
cards.text:
If a rune is active, a friendly hero in radius may:
• {rune_axe}: Swap a resolved card with a card in hand.
• {rune_anvil}: Retrieve all their discarded cards.
• {rune_bird}: Swap one of their items with an item on their card of the same tier and color.

cards.name: Rune Mastery
cards.text: Each time you perform an action, choose one inactive rune; that rune counts as a second active rune for this action.

handicap.name: Rune Shards
handicap.text:
Target a hero adjacent to you; if a rune is active:
{rune_axe}: +3 {attack} Attack.
{rune_anvil}: Gain 2 coins.
{rune_horn}: Repeat once on a different hero in range.

faq.question: How does “choose” work here?
faq.answer: The language is different from “Runetrap” and “Oath of Fortitude” to accommodate Snorri's Ultimate (as there can now be two active runes), the player has to choose one of them. If the Ultimate is not active, there is no choice.

lore: Like any other self-respecting dwarf, Snorri never planned to go on an adventure. That plan went south when his former apprentice strayed from the path of tradition and delved into the murky realm of experimental runic graffiti. Snorri needed to adjust his plans.
